blinding: Random A/B orientation; actor metadata, timestamps, scores, root IDs and source labels withheld. Selected pair handles masked in body. Genre, embedded third-party handles and non-ISO task clocks remain recognizable: partial blinding only.
reading: All 30 redacted pairs read. B02 was initially excerpted at 5000 characters; missing middle of both texts then read separately before judgment. No final text truncation.

criteria.lexical_match: Visible shared exact or near-exact wording, including boilerplate.
criteria.task_specific_content: Shared task-specific payload, numerical facts, parameterized query or prose, not just an administrative sync template. This does NOT establish copying, endorsement or semantic adoption.
criteria.endorsement: Evidence of the specific directed adoption/endorsement link, distinguishable from retained text or common-source exposure. Unknown is not a failure.
